script_text: Stop! Taurus, someone may be testing the terms of a promise you already made. Saturn in Pisces opposes your Taurus Sun, a 1st House to 7th House transit exposing obligations and demanding boundaries. Meanwhile, the Moon in Sagittarius trines Taurus, releasing fear and opening an honest conversation. In love, taken Taurus, don't read silence as betrayal; ask one direct question and listen for accountability. Single Taurus, Venus-ruled Earth energy favors a warm, spontaneous date with someone who respects your pace. Career and money move through your 10th House: negotiate a fee, document a promise, or seek written approval before investing. Jupiter in Gemini sextiles Taurus, expanding opportunities through communication and networking. Avoid signing under pressure or letting pride silence a practical concern. An unexpected gift is a corrected payment or useful introduction. Follow for tomorrow's reading and next Taurus transit.
